t: This is 82 Mortimer Street, a building in Westminster, just north of Oxford Street. It was designed by Arthur Beresford Pite, a British architect who lived from 1861 to 1934. Pite is known for Edwardian buildings, and he worked in several revivalist styles, including Baroque, Byzantine and Greek. So as you look at the facade, you're seeing the work of an architect who liked to borrow boldly from older traditions and mix them into something of his own time.
